blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — The Police Regional Office Mimaropa (Mindoro Occidental and Oriental, Marinduque, Romblon, Palawan) recorded a 51-percent drop in the combined incidence of eight focus crimes from January to October 2026, with monthly incidents falling from 118 to 58—the lowest monthly total logged during the 10-month monitoring period. The eight crime categories—murder, homicide, physical injury, rape, robbery, theft, carnapping, and motorcycle theft—registered 60 fewer incidents in October compared with the January baseline. Monthly monitoring showed incidents at 118 in January, dipping to 88 in April, rising slightly to 94 in May, then falling to 66 in June. […]...
